svg.title: Margaret River (WA) study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Margaret River; 2: Wilyabrup; 3: Cowaramup; 4: Carbunup; 5: Treeton; 6: Karridale; 7: Arumvale; 8: Busselton; 9: Bunbury

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
